_doc: Large batch L10 (Sonnet generic pass): family corrections only; colour/lift/snd left to builder defaults.

tide-crab-knight/f:b1.note: breaker splash is a wave of water; keeps Gauntlet Slam as the plain slash

tide-crab-knight/f:b3.note: scuttle retreat kicks up dust; Duel Call keeps the web snare

coconut-crab-youngster/f:b3.note: sidle scuttle kicks up dust; Husk Toss keeps web

coconut-crab-youngster/f:u0.note: a snip is a pincer bite; bash tag stays mechanical, Hat Bonk is the bash

coconut-crab-youngster/f:u1.note: hiding in the coconut husk: fibrous leaf look, best guess

clam-lurker/f:b0.note: gate swings shut as one streak; Clamp stays the bite

clam-lurker/f:b1.note: yawning spray is a mist puff

clam-lurker/f:b2.note: slimy mantle drips slime; Shut Tight keeps the shield

clam-lurker/f:x0.note: shutter thump is a heavy thump

clam-lurker/f:u2.note: pearl glint: sparkle, clear from the name

clam-lurker/f:u3.note: undertow is current water; Gulping Pull keeps web

giant-clam/f:b0.note: giant shut is jaws closing; Sudden Shut keeps the shock

giant-clam/f:b1.note: shallow spurt is a spray puff

giant-clam/f:b2.note: glossy mantle sheen; Shell Wall keeps the plain shield

giant-clam/f:x0.note: cart-size clap is a heavy thump

giant-clam/f:u1.note: pearl blinds with its glint; ripple is used by Tidal Suck

tide-crab-paladin/f:b1.note: banner spray is a mist puff; Tide Banner keeps ripple

mangrove-crab-king/f:b3.note: scuttle dust; Mud Snatch keeps web

mangrove-crab-emperor/f:b2.note: mudcoat drips mud; Shell Lock keeps the shield
